 Private Equity Master 2:  John Connaughton – Bain Capital (Capital Allocators, EP.201) 
 
 Private Equity Master 2:  John Connaughton – Bain Capital (Capital Allocators, EP.201) Jun 28, 2021

 John Connaughton is a Co-Managing Partner at Bain Capital, a
leading global private investment firm that oversees approximately
$130 billion in assets. Founded in 1984 as the pioneer of a
consulting-based approach to private equity investing, Bain Capital
today invests across private equity, credit, public equity, venture
capital and real estate. Our conversation covers the early years of
private equity at Bain Capital, its growth in products and assets,
investment process, competitive environment, culture, and
succession planning. We close with JC’s insights for allocators and
his outlook on private equity.

 About the Podcast 
 
 
 Allocator and asset management expert, Ted Seides, conducts in-depth interviews with leaders in the institutional investing industry. Guests include Chief Investment Officers from leading allocators, asset managers, strategists, thought leaders, and many more. Our mission is to learn, share, and help implement the process of premier investors. Learn more and join our community at capitalallocators.com.
